builds.name: AR-O tank
builds.desc:
High BST and balanced stats (and availability of course) make Norne a great option for tanking role in Aether Raids offense. Because Spendthrift Bow+ will increase cooldown charge after combat, Lucina: Brave Princess is highly recommended as a support for this build.
Traits: At maximum investment (+10 merge and +10 Dragonflowers), Normalized (neutral) Norne can reach 66 HP with Summoner Support, refined bow and two Mythic Heroes (71 HP with three Mythic Heroes), which helps her avoiding penalties from enemy structures. Less invested Norne can use +Atk or +Spd instead.
Weapon: Spendthrift Bow+ greatly improve Norne's bulk and killing potential.
Special: Noontime for survivability. Also, it's one of a few Special skills that works well with Spendthrift Bow+.
B Passive: Null Follow-Up 3 helps her against many common Aether Raids threats like Eliwood: Knight of Lycia, Bramimond: The Enigma, Sturdy Impact users etc.
C Passive: Pulse Smoke 3 can shut down Infantry Pulse teams and some common threats like Ophelia: Dramatic Heroine and Miracle healers.
Weakness: Although Norne is very bulky with Spendthrift Bow+ with Lucina: Brave Princess support, she still have some weakness. Penalties (from Bright Shrine (D), Dark Shrine (D), Chill skills) can lower Norne's combat performance if the player's offense team isn't built properly. Bulky units with Lunge can separate her from Lucina and make her vulnerable to attacks.
